work-productivity-ontology-typed-workflow-helper 0.1.0

- Initial release focused on supporting ontology-style workflows for work productivity scenarios.
- Provides practical help for bug fixing, setup hardening, reliability improvements, and creating adjacent workflows inspired by proven skill patterns.
- Includes a step-by-step workflow to clarify user needs, generate tailored outputs, validate results, and highlight any remaining risks or follow-up work.
- Outputs reusable templates, checklists, or automation guidance tailored to user requirements.
- Designed for compatibility with local hardware (CPU-friendly, minimal reliance on large models or cloud solutions).
- Includes keyword-based triggers and example usage phrases to activate the skill for relevant requests.

No changes detected in this version; the SKILL.md file remains unchanged.  
- No new features, fixes, or updates were introduced.  
- All workflows, requirements, and triggers are the same as the previous version.
